## What does this pull request do?

<!-- Example: Adds 5 astronomy sentences to id/science. -->

## Type

- [ ] New sentences
- [ ] Fix to an existing sentence or source
- [ ] Code or documentation change

## Sentence checklist (skip for code-only changes)

- [ ] I read `CONTENT_GUIDE.md`
- [ ] One language and one category, at most 20 sentences
- [ ] Each fact is true, and its source URL opens and states that fact
- [ ] The wording is my own, not copied from the source
- [ ] `difficulty` matches the score (`pnpm content:stats --scores`); text uses only keyboard characters and single spaces
- [ ] Ids are unique and continue the numbering in the file
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes (the automatic check on this pull request must be green)
- [ ] If an AI tool helped draft the text, I verified every fact myself

## Notes for reviewers

<!-- Anything unusual: disputed facts, sources in another language, renumbered ids, etc. -->
